description: The chart, Figure 3, illustrates the distribution of datasets by year, categorized by whether they have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition, referred to as "Targeted", and those that do not meet this criterion, labeled as "Untargeted". The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, with the labels displayed at regular intervals. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart features stacked bars for each year, with the "Untargeted" category represented by the lower, blue segment and the "Targeted" category represented by the upper, orange segment. The height of the bars varies across the years, with the shortest bar in 2012, having approximately 5 datasets, and the tallest bar in 2021, reaching around 90 datasets. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, as they are arranged chronologically by year. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of the distribution of targeted and untargeted datasets over time.
